WITH n AS (SELECT 1 AS i UNION ALL SELECT i + 1 FROM n WHERE i < 12)
SELECT FORMAT(DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(GETDATE()), i, 1), 'MMM') AS month,
       ABS(CHECKSUM(NEWID())) % 100 + 50 AS sales
FROM n
